description: Startup: program chains ORDER1 by the passed order id and loads customer name.
derivation: *inzsr: chain 60716 ORDER1 → ORCUID = 1001. GetCusName(1001) → 'Demo Retail One'. Displayed on both panel 1 and FMT02.

description: Subfile load: all four lines of order 60716 are loaded, running totals accumulated.
derivation: s01prp: TOT = 0, TOTVAT = 0. s01lod: SETLL 60716 DETORD1, READE four records. TOT = 12.35 + 0.00 + 126.00 + 99.75 = 238.10. TOTVAT = 12.35 + 0.00 + 126.00 + 99.75 = 238.10 (stored ODTOTVAT used as-is; seed lines have ODTOTVAT = ODTOT). ODQTYLIV and ODTOTVAT are hidden subfile columns (type H in DSPF).

description: Invalid option (e.g. 5) on a subfile row: reverse image set on that row, 'Invalid Option' message shown.
derivation: s01chk: READC returns rrn=1, opt01=5. 5 ≠ 0, 2, 4, 6 → step01 = dsp, dspatr_ri = *on, sflmsg = *on. UPDATE sfl01 writes the row with reverse image. dspatr_ri = *off for next row.

description: Option 4 (delete) rejected because ODQTYLIV > 0: reverse image + delivery-block message.

expected.message_shown: Line with delivery can not be deleted.

derivation: s01chk: READC returns rrn=1, opt01=4, ODQTYLIV=8 > 0 → step01 = dsp, dspatr_ri = *on, sflmsg2 = *on. The first condition (opt01 not in {0,2,4,6}) is false (4 is valid), so sflmsg stays off. No DELETE issued.

description: Option 6 is accepted as valid (no 'Invalid Option') but performs no action.

expected.note: s01act: READC gives opt01=6; no 'when opt01=6' branch exists in s01act's select. Falls through to endsl; no operation performed. The row is unchanged.

derivation: s01chk: opt01=6 is in {0,2,4,6} → no error. ODQTYLIV=0 so delivery-block also skipped. step01 = act. s01act: select has when %error/%eof, when opt01=2, when opt01=4 — no when opt01=6. Falls through, step01 stays act, no further processing.

description: Option 4 deletes a line with no delivery: DETORD1 record deleted, TOT and TOTVAT decremented, subfile row blanked.
derivation: s01act: opt01=4. tot -= odtot: 238.10 - 126.00 = 112.10. totvat -= odtotvat: 238.10 - 126.00 = 112.10. DELETE (60716:3) DETORD1. opt01=0, odarid=' ', odqty=0, odprice=0, odtot=0, artdesc='**** Delete ***'. UPDATE sfl01.

description: Detail screen (FMT02) load: fields copied from DETORD1, VAT recalculated on stored ODTOT for display.
derivation: s02prp: chain (60716:1) DETORD1. DSQTY=1, DSQTYLIV=0, DSPRICE=12.35. GetArtVatCode('000006')='2'. vat = ClcVAT('2', 12.35): 12.35×7.70=95.095, /100=0.95095, Packed(11:4)=0.9509, %dech(0.9509:9:2)=0.95. odtotvat=12.35+0.95=13.30. vatRate=GetVatRate('2')=7.70. Values for display only; DETORD1 not written at this step.

description: Save after editing: ODTOT recalculated, VAT recalculated, five fields written back to DETORD1.
derivation: s02chk: DSQTYLIV(0)≤ODQTY(1) OK; DSQTY(2)≥ODQTYLIV(0) OK. ODTOT=DSQTY×DSPRICE=2×12.35=24.70 (Packed 9:2). VAT=ClcVAT('2',24.70): 24.70×7.70=190.19 (exact 2-dec), /100=1.9019 (Packed 11:4), %dech(1.9019:9:2)=1.90. ODTOTVAT=24.70+1.90=26.60. s02act: change=false → UPDATE fdeto. opt01=0, UPDATE sfl01, panel=1.

description: ERR1001: DSQTYLIV entered > ODQTY stored at load time — screen redisplayed, no save.

message_on_field.text: Delivered quantity must be lower or equal to ordered quantity.

derivation: s02chk: DSQTYLIV(4) > ODQTY(3) stored at load time → errqtyliv = *on, step02 = dsp. ErrQty(*IN38) check: DSQTY(3) ≥ ODQTYLIV(0) → no error. Note Q5: ErrQtyLiv is never set *off, so ERR1001 persists on every subsequent visit to FMT02 for the same program run.

description: ERR1002: DSQTY entered < ODQTYLIV stored at load time — screen redisplayed, no save.

message_on_field.text: Ordered quantity can not be lower than the quantity already delivered.

derivation: s02chk: DSQTYLIV(8) ≤ ODQTY(20) stored → no ERR1001. DSQTY(7) < ODQTYLIV(8) stored → errqty = *on, step02 = dsp. Note Q6: comparison is against ODQTY stored at load (20), not against the new DSQTY(7), so the ERR1001 gate (8 ≤ 20) passes even though the new quantities would be inconsistent.

description: Half-rounding quirk: intermediate Packed(11:4) = 0.3850; %dech rounds half-up to 0.39, not half-even 0.38.

order.note: Custom order added for this case; not in seed data.

detord.note: Custom line: price 5.00 chosen so net×rate/100 = 0.3850 exactly before rounding.

derivation: R12: ODTOT = 1 × 5.00 = 5.00. R13: ClcVAT('2', 5.00): VATRATE=7.70. tot (Packed 11:4) = (5.00 × 7.70) / 100 = 38.50 / 100 = 0.38500; truncated to 4 decimals = 0.3850. %dech(0.3850 : 9 : 2): 3rd decimal = 5 → half-up rounds up the 2nd decimal: 0.38 → 0.39. Java BigDecimal.HALF_EVEN would give 0.38 (2nd decimal 8 is even). Any port must produce 0.39.

description: Unknown VAT code: ClcVAT silently returns 0.00, ODTOTVAT equals ODTOT with no error shown.

vatdef.note: Code '9' is intentionally absent from VATDEF.

derivation: ODTOT = 10 × 1.25 = 12.50. ClcVAT('9', 12.50): chainVATDEF('9') — 'clear *all FVAT' → VATRATE=0.00; CHAIN '9' VATDEF → %found=false; VATRATE stays 0.00. tot = (12.50 × 0.00) / 100 = 0.0000. VAT = 0.00. ODTOTVAT = 12.50 + 0.00 = 12.50. No error indicator set; ORD101 never calls ExistVATRate before ClcVAT.

description: Deleted VAT code: ClcVAT uses the stored rate (10.00%) regardless of VATDEL='X'.
derivation: ODTOT = 4 × 7.50 = 30.00. ClcVAT('3', 30.00): chainVATDEF('3') — CHAIN '3' VATDEF hits the record (%found=true); VATDEL='X' is NOT checked. VATRATE=10.00. tot = (30.00 × 10.00) / 100 = 300.00 / 100 = 3.0000 (Packed 11:4). %dech(3.0000:9:2) = 3.00. ODTOTVAT = 30.00 + 3.00 = 33.00. ExistVATRate('3') would return false, but ORD101 never calls it.

description: Ordered quantity = 0: ODTOT = 0.00, VAT = 0.00, ODTOTVAT = 0.00.
Delivered quantity equals ordered quantity: both validation checks pass (edge: DSQTYLIV = ODQTY and DSQTY = ODQTYLIV).
derivation: R10: DSQTYLIV(6) ≤ ODQTY stored(6) → OK (boundary passes). R11: DSQTY(6) ≥ ODQTYLIV stored(6) → OK. R12: ODTOT = 6 × 6.25 = 37.50. R13: ClcVAT('2', 37.50): VATRATE=7.70. 3750 × 770 = 2,887,500; /10,000 = 288.75 (exact 2-decimal product). 288.75 / 100 = 2.8875 → Packed(11:4) = 2.8875. %dech(2.8875:9:2): 3rd decimal = 7 ≥ 5, round up: 2.88 → 2.89. ODTOTVAT = 37.50 + 2.89 = 40.39.
